## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass (see CONTRIBUTING.md for the exact commands)
- [ ] A `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `[Unreleased]`, if a user would notice the change
- [ ] ASTAP-compatible flags, stdout, output files and exit codes are unchanged, or the change is called out
- [ ] For changes to detection, matching, the search or the fit: benchmark results before and after (`scripts/benchmark.py`)
